blurb: Guests do a tandem skydive attached to an instructor, including 15 minutes of training and a jump from 10,000 ft. The experience includes ground preparation, gearing up, a freefall of about 30 seconds, and a canopy flight lasting 5 to 10 minutes with views over Vernon. Licensed skydivers can also jump from 10,000 ft with gear rental available.
